Fan-produced high-resolution (600 dpi) image of [[Depa Billaba (V)]] from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]]. This face prints “forfeit = 0”. The published current full face at [[:File:V7-L-depabillaba.gif]] prints “forfeit for 0”. The fan image remains preserved; an exact whole-face match to a published version has not been established.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 7/Light/Depa Billaba.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jlOOr7uTpw9t6WRoIpS_cetJzTr21clg/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Depa Billaba.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,260 bytes, SHA-256 <code>7b586ee53883bcde84deef5b23c40ecab968c81dae1905efc22f6eb15822ee9d</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V7-L-depabillaba.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
